gates.required_evidence: One successful native matrix per announced OS, version and architecture, executed without sudo, container or cleartext fallback.
systemvault-anti-leak.json from an actual profile to encrypted backup to isolated restore flow, without exposing the sentinel.
Detached signature, separately published public key, approved fingerprint and independent verification attestation.
Recorded legal and distribution review of the exact runtime packages and their licenses.
Compatibility matrix limited to configurations with complete runtime and native SystemVault evidence.

promotion_rule: All gates must be explicitly changed to PASSED with versioned evidence and independently reviewed before PUBLIC_RELEASE_APPROVED may be considered.
